name: tsh-agentic-collections
description: The Software House agentic collections: Claude Code plugins organized per discipline, per technology stack, and a small shared core.

plugins.name: tsh-core
plugins.description: What every TSH teammate needs regardless of discipline or stack: safe Git worktree lifecycle management, the house standard for writing technical documents, authoring Claude Code extensions, the project-context files Claude Code loads, the decision-record format and lifecycle, a one-command project setup that wires them all together, and a bundled Atlassian MCP server for Jira and Confluence.

plugins.name: tsh-product-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven feature implementation: committed plan files, delegated implementer subagents, and TSH's structured pre-merge code review.

plugins.name: tsh-product-testing
plugins.description: Quality assurance: Playwright end-to-end tests that do not flake, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audits that report the success criterion behind every finding.

plugins.name: tsh-product-management
plugins.description: The business-analysis workflow end to end: discovery workshop materials — transcripts, Figma, PDFs, codebase context — become Jira-ready epics and user stories and an outcome-based delivery roadmap, behind five human review gates, with a hook that blocks any Jira write before the push gate is approved. Also imports an existing Jira backlog for local iteration. Six read-only worker subagents keep the heavy reading out of the conversation.

plugins.name: tsh-product-design
plugins.description: UI/UX design work, design systems, design review and Figma-driven flows.

plugins.name: tsh-platform-engineering
plugins.description: Infrastructure, CI/CD and deployment the TSH way: Terraform modules, pipelines with OIDC and plan gates, production-shaped Kubernetes workloads, observability with SLOs, secrets management, and evidence-based cloud cost audits.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-frontend
plugins.description: TSH conventions for browser-targeted frontend code: TypeScript compiler configuration for bundler-resolved applications, starting with React and Vite.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-nodejs
plugins.description: TSH conventions for TypeScript on Node.js: compiler configuration for a Node runtime, and NestJS API implementation and review.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-aws
plugins.description: AWS-specific infrastructure guidance: Terraform module patterns for VPC, EKS, RDS and S3, Well-Architected defaults, and a full evidence-based AWS cost and tagging audit of a live account.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-azure
plugins.description: Azure-specific infrastructure guidance: Terraform module patterns for VNet, AKS, Flexible Server, Blob Storage, Application Gateway and Key Vault, Managed Identity and private-endpoint defaults, and a full evidence-based Azure cost and tagging audit driven by Resource Graph and Cost Management.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-gcp
plugins.description: GCP-specific infrastructure guidance: Terraform module patterns for VPC, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage and Cloud Run, Workload Identity and CMEK defaults, and a full evidence-based GCP cost and labelling audit of a live project.

plugins.name: tsh-stack-python
plugins.description: TSH conventions for modern Python 3.12+: general implementation and review practices, and Pydantic v2/dataclass/SQLModel/SQLAlchemy 2.0 data modeling.
